notes.title: UPDATE FOR PARASITE FIGHTER!
notes.notes:
Here we go again!!!

So, I've been working hard the last few weekends and every moment I could dedicate to Parasite Fighter / Kring!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/4256d370c46f42d26de6f27d9894247bf1988ee2.png

Lots of new things! All for Parasite Fighter
1) I also added control via Pad controller. So now you can play it with mouse, keyboard or game pad!
2) I developed Progression well, which in practical terms means a sensible distribution of number of enemies, type and quantity of power-ups, and difficulty curve.
Let me know what you think, to better balance the game!
3) I inserted particular objects, the DRONES, which if touched by the spaceship activate and do things, positive for us and very bad for the enemies. There are 4 of them, you can find them in particular from the second level onwards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/6f9dc852fa8dfa3624faec96341fb0a40dfa4bea.png
4) I inserted the TIME FOR CARNAGE, so now there is a maximum time to eat all the parasites on the screen, which makes the matter much more "challenging".
It still needs to be calibrated well, but it already forces you to get busy biting and biting as much as you can!
5) I added artificial intelligence (big word!) to the enemies, which therefore now move in a much more varied way than before, from wave to wave.
6) I added animations for the enemies, which now move with greater variety.

Furthermore, I had included multilingual support, which also worked, but due to a (apparently known) Game Maker problem in displaying particular characters (for German and Spanish), I had to remove it.
If I understand how to solve it (for now without success) I will re-implement it, otherwise the game will remain only ITA-ENG.

Next discount for Kring expected just after Christmas.

CIAOOOOOOOOO

notes.title: Old version of the Genesis game now restored
notes.notes:
I reactivated the old version of Genesis! Which those who saw the birth of Kring know.... 
[previewyoutube=OJNQ96ZCWkM;full][/previewyoutube]

Since it's really weird and cryptic, I decided a while back to remake it from scratch by making the gameplay a little more intelligible and flowing by putting an option that allowed the old version to be reactivated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/ade816da8111594d9103b9fa2bdf04ccf9cd714d.png

Then, in the weeks before the release, seeing that crashes generated by the old code from the old version of Genesis would pop up from time to time, I disabled it and made it inaccessible in order to prevent the game from crashing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/c970e2b16af61683a4b2cf478136400b41f3060e.png
Now I've caught the bug that generated the crash -- I hope no more mysterious ones pop up! The code in the old version of Genesis is really old and rather fragile... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/1b5b41591159168cefe0d5b882c035c14bc18279.png
Go into the OPTIONS and turn on the second-to-last option “GENESIS VERSION” to “ORIGINAL and CRYPTIC”
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/71e60ea0b3ac4642793f0f4222185ab58a20c97e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/e55ee1ecdcc88634276d1bbcdc3fdb2ac38d1079.png

Also:
- PARASITE FIGHTER: I inserted PAUSE!!! Press the “P” key to pause the game. It looks like a small thing but it's not :) basically I had to put my hands in all the items in the game!
But now it's done and it will also come in handy for future developments of the game.
- I also added new firing types and animations of the spaceship when it fires. If you want the cheat to change the firing type, press F5 during the game.

- BIODISSEY: Now, when you enter Biodissey you will find available all the resources you have collected in New Genesis.
Now, accessing Biodissey (which is the 4X section of Kring - yet another game within a game!) is not a simple matter: first you have to finish all of New Genesis, collecting as many resources as you can; then go to the Leaderboard (on the icon of which will be Biodissey), you will see all the resources you have collected, and click the Rotating Star; so you go to the Tartar screen, which will look different than usual. Load up your Kring army and set off. There you will arrive in the Biodissey, with all the resources (that you have previously collected in New Genesis) available!

Note: Biodissey is still LOTS of work-in-progress. As soon as I finish Parasite Fighter (in which I now have to implement the artificial intelligences of the various enemies and create a decent increasing difficulty progression) I'll get back into it and finish it. I can't wait to get back into healthy data game design!

I hope that some of you guys will play this new Kring version and tell me what you think!
Have a great week!

Ivan Venturi

notes.title: PARASITE FIGHTER - alpha version
notes.notes:
And here is the alpha version of the new minigame (which you can play by clicking NOVELTY GAME in the main menu): PARASITE FIGHTER!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42892703/fd8648602ae5a5a9668469554bc878ca2e0b6275.png

You can use mouse or keyboard (WASD or ARROWS and space/control/enter keys). Best with mouse.
Left key: shoot. There is no limit of shots, so go ahead and shoot tons of bullets.
Right key: boost temporary. If you want to go fast, click a lot!

For now there are:
- 10 waves, each with a different enemy. The artificial intelligence of the various enemies is still super-silent, but it already gives flavor to exterminate them!
- 3 game stages: NATURAL, MICRO, SUPERHOT, to which is added the PARASITE MOTHER final boss stage at the end of each level. There are 5 different Parasite Mother for now (in the end of 5 different levels).
- Endless levels of increasing difficulty. Linear progression, minimal difficulty balance.

[previewyoutube=UyoG8al1Bx4;full][/previewyoutube]

Collect the various power-ups (temporary graphics) found for:
- SPEED
- SHIELD.
- SHOOTING TYPE.
- MANEUVERABILITY.


Let me know what you think!

I'm leaving for Gamescom now, but as soon as I can I'll do:

 player's starship graphics
 power-up graphics
 special actions and attacks for each type of enemy
 enemy AIs
 a nicely designed title
 a nice opening screen to let you know where you are fighting (you are inside an alien plant, reduced to microscopic size, and you have to eliminate all the parasites to save said plant)
 audio SFX


Saludos!
